title: Tissue versus bath constraint attribution in the pinned Vitrify phantom
question: Does requiring surrounding CPA as well as myocardium change frozen schedule rankings or thermal feasibility, and which domains set the constraints?
method: Predefined 2 schedules x 2 loadings x 2 SAR readings at .75 mm; high/clamped and nominal/extrapolated pairs at .5 mm with .01/.005 s exact-horizon conservative RK2; six domain masks with full-cell minima, endpoint, crossing and failure-volume diagnostics.
result: Informative null: no domain-dependent decision or ranking changes. Myocardium sets all cold endpoints; surrounding CPA sets all hot endpoints and most restricted-window minima. Exact rate-bottleneck attribution can change with voxelization.

numerical_claims.name: domain_ranking_changes
numerical_claims.unit: of 8 numerical schedule pairs per rate screen

limitations: Synthetic geometry, uniform myocardial loading, substituted CPA properties, unresolved SAR reading and adiabatic boundary.
Deterministic parameter scenarios and overlapping domain masks are not independent replicates.
Near-tied spatial attribution and endpoint values depend on voxelization; only predefined subset refined.
No measured loading/CPA/temperature maps, ice, mechanics or biological validation; isolated tissue screen is not biological safety.
No human expert review; no universal novelty claim.

scientific_assessment.limit: No feasibility decision or paired ranking changed.
